title: Reflect
description: Night-sky violet: a near-black indigo page, lavender-white ink with 60% lavender secondary text, lavender hairlines, deep violet buttons with a lilac rim and an inner glow, one #9382ff violet for emphasis and violet-to-blue light for glows. A rounded geometric grotesk at weight 500 for gradient-filled headings, Inter for text, 8px corners.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling in the same spirit (pale lavender page, indigo ink, the same violet)
Figtree stands in for AeonikPro (commercial); Inter is the original's body face
chart-2 → chart-3 → chart-4 is the pink→lilac→periwinkle price gradient; glow is the violet of the light effects
